searchText: Hey guys! I don't know where exactly to ask this, but can you help me with the openethereum node? We got a pretty weird rpc behavior, sometimes calling eth_getTransactionReceipt method returns null instead of valid answer. But after some time (like 5-10 seconds) same exact rpc call returns valid answer again. And in that time all other eth_getTransactionReceipt requests with different txs also returns null.
